title: Economic Valuation of Non Timber Forest Products Contribution in Tribal Livelihood in West Singhbhum District of Jharkhand

scope.study_scope_as_reported_by_source_abstra: 50 selected villages; the publisher abstract reports evaluation of NTFP contribution to tribal livelihoods and states that six major NTFPs from forests managed under a 'Mundari-khuntkattidari' system were included.
scope.allowed_repository_proposition_at_curren: The publisher metadata and abstract report a 2011 West Singhbhum study with the stated title, authors, DOI, pages, 50-village scope, and an abstract-level reference to forests described by the authors as managed under a Mundari-khuntkattidari system.
not_allowed_inference: The abstract is not evidence that all Munda communities use the described management system.
The source is not treated as present-day representativeness evidence.
No participant-level, village-level, customary-law, ownership, ecological, economic, or cultural practice claim is promoted without exact-locator full-text review.
